biggest_catch: Insense is brand-facing: its official pages describe creator payments only as 'negotiated per campaign' with safe-payment escrow — no per-video rate, range, or minimum exists anywhere on its official domain.
catches: The official creator-facing page (insense.pro/blog/best-ugc-content-creator-platform) describes payment safety (brand payment frozen at hire, wallet, PayPal/bank withdrawal) but states zero dollar figures for creator pay.
Per-campaign pay is negotiated with each brand — earnings depend entirely on brand selection with no stated minimums.

The concrete dollar figures on Insense's official site are all brand-side (subscription plans $1,500-$2,400/quarter) or affiliate-referral fees ($100-$150 per client referred) — not creator content pay.
3,000+ active campaigns is a volume claim, not a pay claim.

c1.evidence: No concrete creator pay figure (no per-video rate, range, or minimum) found on any official Insense page (insense.pro, help.insense.pro).

c2.evidence: Insense.pro is the official domain (UGC platform for brands); official pages loaded describe the platform without creator pay figures.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee information for creators found on official pages; cannot confirm — treated as unverified rather than assumed.

c4.evidence: No payout timing for creator content pay published on official pages (affiliate referral timing is published, but that is a different program).

eligibility: Unknown from official creator-pay perspective — not stated.
notes: REJECT is a verifiability verdict, not a scam flag: Insense is a real UGC platform (3,500+ DTC brands cited), but the strict checklist requires a concrete payout in official terms and none exists for creator content work. Do not list this route as verified. Re-check if Insense publishes a creator rate card.

s4.note: Volume claims ('3,000+ active campaigns') are presented near payment-safety copy, implying earning ease without any pay figure.
